idea-plugin.name: GKE Extended Channel Fee Lint
idea-plugin.description:
GKE Extended channel fee check for Terraform: 14 rules on google_container_cluster versions, fee start dates, forced upgrades and Extended channel blockers

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → GKE Extended Channel Fee Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 14 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/gke-extended-channel-fee-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/gke-extended-channel-fee-lint

action.text: GKE Extended Channel Fee Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run GKE Extended Channel Fee Lint on the file in the editor
